comment: Event calendar loader configuration. Weights are provisional until calibrated from realized variance (docs/risk/margin-model.md section 6.3) and must stay within the endpoint bounds [0, 10].

fomc.name: Federal Reserve FOMC
fomc.time_basis: published: statement released at 2:00 p.m. ET on the last day of the meeting

ecb.name: European Central Bank
ecb.time_basis: published: decision released at 14:15 CET on day 2 of the meeting

boj.name: Bank of Japan
boj.time_basis: convention: the BoJ publishes no fixed release time; 12:00 JST on the last day of the meeting

rba.name: Reserve Bank of Australia
rba.time_basis: published: statement at 2:30 p.m. Sydney time on the second day of the meeting

snb.name: Swiss National Bank
snb.time_basis: published: press release time listed in the SNB event schedule

boc.name: Bank of Canada
boc.time_basis: published: interest rate announcements at 9:45 a.m. ET

rbi.name: Reserve Bank of India
rbi.time_basis: convention: resolution announced around 10:00 IST on the last day of the meeting

bok.name: Bank of Korea
bok.time_basis: convention: decision announced in the morning of the meeting day; 10:00 KST

us_cpi.name: US CPI release (BLS schedule, via FRED)
us_cpi.time_basis: published: BLS releases at 8:30 a.m. ET

us_payrolls.name: US Employment Situation (BLS schedule, via FRED)
us_payrolls.time_basis: published: BLS releases at 8:30 a.m. ET

unsupported.rbnz: Reserve Bank of New Zealand: the official schedule page answers 403 to automated clients
unsupported.banxico: Banco de Mexico: the official calendar is filled in by browser-side script, no static schedule to read
unsupported.bcb: Banco Central do Brasil: no machine-readable official Copom schedule found; the site is a browser application
unsupported.bcch: Banco Central de Chile: the site serves a bot challenge to automated clients
unsupported.mas: Monetary Authority of Singapore: the advance release calendar gives only 'no later than' dates, not exact days
unsupported.cbc: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan): no official English schedule of board meetings found
unsupported.pboc: People's Bank of China: no fixed monetary policy decision schedule is published
unsupported.bls: Bureau of Labor Statistics: answers 403 to automated clients; its schedule is read through FRED instead
